title: Detecting Malicious Agent Skills in the Wild using Attention
title_zh: 使用 Attention 检测真实市场中的恶意 Agent Skills
abstract_en: LLM agents increasingly load skills, file-based packages of natural-language instructions written by third parties and distributed through marketplaces, that execute with the user's privileges. A single malicious skill can exfiltrate data, hijack the agent, or persist as a supply-chain foothold, which turns the skill marketplace into a new attack surface for agentic systems. Prompt-injection defenses do not carry over to this setting. They rely on a boundary between trusted instructions and untrusted data, whereas a skill is itself a body of instructions, so an injected command sits among many legitimate ones and inherits their authority. We present Locate-and-Judge, a two-stage detector designed for this regime. A lightweight locator scores the structural spans of a skill by the instruction-following attention each span draws and retains only the top-K. A judge then examines the retained spans in detail. Concentrating the costly judgment on a few high-attention spans lets the detector audit an entire marketplace instead of a sample. Compared to direct LLM-based scanning, this approach offers an order-of-magnitude cost reduction, dramatically increasing its scalability at a small cost to recall, and it dominates keyword and regex baselines at comparable expense. Deployed at marketplace scale and at negligible cost, Locate-and-Judge flags skills with high precision, the majority of which we manually confirmed as malicious, surfacing dozens of live malicious skills, including several disguised as benign functionality and many that SkillSpector and Cisco Skill Scanner fail to detect. We release the resulting labeled dataset.
abstract_zh: 随着 LLM agents 越来越多地加载由第三方编写并通过 marketplace 分发的 skills（基于文件的自然语言指令包），这些 skills 会以用户权限执行，因而带来新的供应链攻击面。单个恶意 skill 可能窃取数据、劫持 agent，或作为持久化攻击入口。传统 prompt-injection 防御依赖“可信指令”和“不可信数据”的边界，但 skill 本身就是指令集合，恶意命令会混杂在合法指令中并继承其权限，因此难以直接适用。论文提出 Locate-and-Judge，一种两阶段检测器：首先用轻量级 locator 根据各结构化 span 获得的 instruction-following attention 打分，并保留 top-K 高风险片段；随后由 judge 对这些片段进行细粒度审查。该设计将昂贵的 LLM 判断集中在少量高 attention 区域，使其能够以低成本审计整个 marketplace。相比直接基于 LLM 的扫描，Locate-and-Judge 将成本降低约一个数量级，仅牺牲少量召回率，并在相近成本下优于 keyword 和 regex baselines。大规模部署结果显示，该方法能以高 precision 标记恶意 skills，其中多数经人工确认，发现了数十个真实在线恶意 skills，包括伪装成正常功能的样本，以及许多 SkillSpector 和 Cisco Skill Scanner 未能检出的样本。作者还发布了相应的标注数据集。
key_points_zh: 问题聚焦于 LLM agent skill marketplace 的新型供应链风险：skills 是带权限执行的自然语言指令包，恶意指令可隐藏在合法指令中。
提出 Locate-and-Judge 两阶段框架：locator 用 instruction-following attention 选择 top-K 可疑结构 span，judge 再对这些片段进行深入判别。
相比直接 LLM 全量扫描，该方法实现约一个数量级的成本降低，仅带来小幅 recall 损失，适合 marketplace-scale 审计。
在同等成本下，Locate-and-Judge 优于 keyword 和 regex baselines，并发现大量现有工具 SkillSpector、Cisco Skill Scanner 漏检的恶意 skills。
论文发布了经检测与人工确认形成的 labeled dataset，为后续 agent skill 安全研究提供基准资源。

llm_assessment.comment: Strong agent-security paper addressing marketplace-scale malicious skill detection, a concrete and important production harness risk.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 这是一篇很强的智能体安全论文，面向市场规模的恶意技能检测，解决了具体且重要的生产级框架风险。
